Alex Chen: Hey finance — I paid for booth freight + customs clearance at Dublin port on my personal card. Carrier sent a single invoice with freight and a separate line for customs duties. I need to split the total across 3 cost centers (Product Marketing / Events / Field Eng). Quick Qs: is customs duty reimbursable? how should I enter currency conversion? and what GL/code do we use for customs vs freight?

Maya Patel: Short answer: customs duties are reimbursable for event shipments, but we need the vendor invoice + proof of payment + bill of lading or customs manifest. For GLs, freight goes to 6400 (Logistics) and customs/fees go to 6425 (Duties & Fees).

Liam O'Connor: One nuance — if the invoice includes VAT, we treat VAT differently (potential reclaim) but most customs duties are non-recoverable. If there's VAT, attach the separate VAT line or receipt.

Alex Chen: Got it. I uploaded the invoice and proof of payment to Ramp under my expenses (see link: https://ramp.com/receipts/abc123). The invoice number is INV-2025-4482 and the carrier reference is DHL-987654.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: please include allocation amounts in the expense form. Required fields: cost_centers (list), allocation_percentages, payment_method, original_currency, amount_in_original_currency. Missing: allocation_percentages.

Alex Chen: Allocation I'm proposing:
Product Marketing: 50%
Events: 30%
Field Eng: 20%
Total invoice EUR 2,430.50 (customs EUR 430.50, freight EUR 2,000.00). Payment posted on 2025-04-11. Would you prefer we split by percent above or exact EUR amounts?

Maya Patel: Percent is fine — we'll record the split and post to the three cost centers. For currency conversion, we'll use the card transaction FX rate on 2025-04-11. Please add the card FX fee line if Ramp shows one.

Alex Chen: Ramp shows FX rate and EUR->USD converted amount. No separate FX fee line. I added the converted USD total and screenshot of the transaction.

Liam O'Connor: Also tagging @Finance Team for signoff on whether customs is allowed as reimbursable for customer-facing booth shipments (should be yes). :eyes:

Finance Team: Confirmed — customs duties for inbound event freight are reimbursable. Please code customs to 6425 and freight to 6400. We'll process the reimbursement to your bank on next AP run (two business days).

Alex Chen: Amazing, thanks! Do you need my bank details or should I select reimbursement via payroll?

Maya Patel: Bank transfer is preferred for one-off reimbursements. If you haven't added details in Ramp, DM me the last 4 of your account and the name on file and we'll pull the info.

Alex Chen: DM'd you the last 4 and snapshot of the bank form. Thanks everyone :clap:

ExpenseBot: Expense submitted (INV-2025-4482) — status: awaiting AP review.

Maya Patel: I'll pick this up in the AP queue and mark as split across cost centers as requested. Expect reimbursement in 2 business days after approval. :white_check_mark:
